processMode.description: softpqe process mode, 0: run Y and UV, 1: run UV only, 2: run Y only

multiThreadMode.description: Use multiple threads for Y/UV process

autoDetectUvDownScale.description: Detect the down scale of UV model automatically

autoUvDownScaleConfig.description: [Internal use] The down scale level of UV model when autoDetectUvDownScale is 1

dumpDataMode.description: softpqe dump data mode, 0: dump input/output yuv/png, 1: dump input/output yuv only

enableSuperResolution.description: Enable/Disable super resolution (Y model), 0: disable, 1: output ori size, 2: output scale size

defaultAlgoConfig.description: The file name of default config
